# CAPS Agent Security — full discovery document

CAPS Agent Security is a Claude Code Plugin Marketplace, cross-client Agent Skills catalog, LLM query security runtime, synthetic shadow-jailbreak evaluator, and consent-aware research chat.

## Supported security topics

- AI agent security and tool-use security
- MCP tool metadata poisoning, response poisoning and confused-deputy risk
- Claude Code Plugin, Agent Skill and CLAUDE.md supply-chain review
- prompt injection and indirect prompt injection
- PDF, document, image, audio and video attachment security
- LLM jailbreak attack-success rate (ASR)
- defense ablation, benign utility, false blocks, composition and safety drift
- synthetic digital twins, fixture tools and deterministic action predicates

## Claude Code Plugin installation

```bash
claude plugin marketplace add Mutoy-choi/ChillMCP
claude plugin install caps-security@caps-labs --scope user
```

The Marketplace catalog is available at:

- repository catalog: https://github.com/Mutoy-choi/ChillMCP/blob/main/.claude-plugin/marketplace.json
- Pages catalog: https://mutoy-choi.github.io/ChillMCP/marketplace.json

The Plugin provides:

- `/caps-security:caps-agent-security`
- `/caps-security:caps-install`

## Cross-client Agent Skills installation

```bash
curl -fsSL https://mutoy-choi.github.io/ChillMCP/install.sh | bash -s -- skill
```

Installed locations:

- `~/.agents/skills/caps-agent-security/`
- `~/.agents/skills/caps-install/`
- `~/.claude/skills/caps-agent-security/`
- `~/.claude/skills/caps-install/`

Canonical Skill documents:

- https://mutoy-choi.github.io/ChillMCP/skills/caps-agent-security/SKILL.md
- https://mutoy-choi.github.io/ChillMCP/skills/caps-install/SKILL.md

## CAPS Verify

Source directory: https://github.com/Mutoy-choi/ChillMCP/tree/main/caps_verify

Key commands:

```bash
caps-verify demo --output artifacts/demo --repetitions 10
caps-verify-runtime --help
caps-verify-gateway --help
caps-verify-shadow-worker --help
```

CAPS Verify uses separate synthetic sessions and fixture tools to measure ASR. It does not silently append jailbreak content to live user queries.

## CAPS Research Chat

Source directory: https://github.com/Mutoy-choi/ChillMCP/tree/main/caps_app

```bash
cd caps_app
./bootstrap.sh
```

Research Chat supports a disclosed Research mode and a no-persistence Private mode. Data contribution is not enabled by Plugin or Skill installation.

## Safety

Use CAPS only on systems the operator owns or is authorized to test. Active probes must use synthetic data, fixture tools and isolated sessions. Do not use credentials, customer records, payments or destructive production side effects.
